This year, we are commemorating 250 years of American freedom. In Nebraska, we know America is always worth celebrating. 

To be part of celebrations across our state, visit: america250.org/calendar/?vie…

Enjoyed starting my morning yesterday at the kick-off celebration for the Warrior Bike Ride across the country on the National Mall!
 
I had the pleasure of meeting Winston Hall, a proud Nebraskan from Elkhorn and a U.S. Army Vietnam veteran. Mr. Hall will be participating in the 75-day cross-country bikepacking trip along the Great American Rail-Trail.
 
Best of luck on your trip, Mr. Hall, and thank you for your service!

Thank you @TulsiGabbard for your service at @ODNIgov. Susanne and I will keep you and your husband in our prayers in the days ahead.


Tulsi Gabbard 🌺 (@TulsiGabbard)

I am deeply grateful for the trust President Trump placed in me and for the opportunity to lead @ODNIgov for the last year and a half. 

Unfortunately, I must submit my resignation, effective June 30, 2026. My husband, Abraham, has recently been diagnosed with an extremely rare form of bone cancer. He faces major challenges in the

To celebrate National Beef Month, I introduced a bill that protects real meat. Deceptive labeling of plant-based protein products hurts American farmers and ranchers.

It also degrades consumer trust.

The FAIR Labels Act would prohibit labeling plant-based or cell-based alternatives as “meat.” That name should be reserved for the real thing–especially Nebraska beef.

Today, I called for a voice vote on the Senate floor to declare May Renewable Fuels Month.  It passed.

Renewable fuels are great for consumers to help save you money at the pump.  Last time I filled up with a 10% blend of ethanol, I saved 55 cents a gallon at my local grocery store. @RepDonBacon told me that he is saving $1 a gallon with E15.

Renewable fuels are also great for cleaning up the environment and, of course, great for our farmers and ranchers.

Renewable fuels are part of an Americ

Agriculture is the heart and soul of what we do in Nebraska.  Family farms and ranches are the backbone of our communities. I’m fighting to keep more money in the pockets of Nebraska farmers and ranchers.

The Working Families Tax Cuts helps Nebraska producers grow and reinvest. This landmark legislation unleashes Nebraska’s power to fuel the world, supports the next generation of ag leaders through a strengthened Beginning Farmer and Rancher Development Benefit, and makes the Qualified Business

Glad to see @EPA and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers finalize the cleanup plan for groundwater in Grand Island!

This is good news for Nebraska.
epa.gov/newsreleases/epa-and…

E15 is a win-win-win. It saves Nebraskans money at the pump, is good for the environment, and helps farmers get better prices for their corn and soybeans.

We need to get year-round E15 done.
omaha.com/news/state-regiona…

Yesterday on the Senate floor, I expressed my support for Nebraska farmers and ranchers and highlighted our state's leadership in beef and renewable fuels. 

I also talked about my MARKET Act, which will diversify Nebraska ag exports away from Communist China.

Video

The wildfires across Western Nebraska are the worst since we became a state. They have burned over 1,000,000 acres.

I joined a letter with @SenatorFischer, @USRepMikeFlood, @RepDonBacon, and @RepAdrianSmith in support of Governor Pillen’s support for a major disaster declaration.

We know Nebraskans are resilient. We support our state’s ongoing efforts.

Today I introduced a resolution designating May as Renewable Fuels Month. 

Nebraska is a national leader in biofuels production, making 2.2 billion gallons each year.

This home-grown energy supports our economy – helping farmers get better prices for their corn and soybeans and saving consumers money at the pump.

Our biofuels are a win for Nebraska and America.

Nebraska farmers and ranchers feed and fuel the world. While China remains an export market for many of Nebraskan products, it has not always been a reliable trading partner.

That’s why I introduced the MARKET Act. This legislation would require the @USDA and the @USTradeRep to look at other markets so we can diversify our exports.

Finding new markets will prevent Nebraska farmers and ranchers from being beholden to Communist China.

The Department of Interior and U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service recently announced an opportunity for grazing access of 13,000 acres at Valentine National Wildlife Refuge.

As we rebuild from the historic wildfires, we need to support Nebraska farmers and ranchers.

Nebraskans can access the application at the link below. The deadline to apply is May 22. I encourage farmers and ranchers seeking access to new grazing resources to apply!

fws.gov/service/valentine-na…

For the 12th straight month, there have been zero illegal immigrants released at the southern border.

@SenateGOP and @POTUS are delivering on our promises. The border is secure. We’re keeping Nebraskans safe.


Secretary Markwayne Mullin (@SecMullinDHS)

Twelve straight months of ZERO releases at the border.

Under @POTUS Trump’s leadership, the days of catch and release are over.

We are enforcing our nation’s laws and sending illegal aliens BACK to their home countries.





— https://nitter.

Susanne and I are praying for the Nebraskans impacted by the storms that tore through central Nebraska last night. We are also grateful to our brave first responders for their quick responses in helping our communities.
